text:
Elyse Park: Hi team, unboxing my desk kit and a couple issues — USB-C dock arrived but no power brick in the box, dock LEDs don't light and monitor connected to the dock flickers intermittently. Also when I try to join redwood-sec I get "certificate validation failed" during auth. Anyone seen this before?
Carlos Ramos: welcome Elyse! @Elyse Park ping IT here and DM the packing slip if you can. also we do a quick welcome call at 3pm if you want to join :wave:
IT_Support: Sorry about the kit. Can you share the dock model/serial and the laptop OS? For the Wi-Fi cert error, do you see a popup about an untrusted root CA or a connection timeout?
Elyse Park: Dock model: RWD-DOCK-USB4-002, serial DOCK-7F9B. MacBook Pro 14" macOS 13.6. The Wi-Fi error says: "EAP: TLS handshake failed - certificate validation failed (ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID)"
infra-bot: Ticket created: INC-2026-0389 assigned to it_support (priority: high).
IT_Support: Thanks. Two quick things: 1) Try a direct power outlet (no power strip) and reconnect the dock power cable — see if LEDs appear. 2) For the cert issue, we recently rotated our onboarding RADIUS certs; macOS sometimes caches the old root. Go to https://intranet.redwood.dev/it/root-cert and install the new root cert, then reboot and retry. If you get a modal, choose "Always Trust" for the certificate.
Elyse Park: Tried the outlet and still nothing. Attached screenshot of the Wi-Fi modal (sending in thread).
Elyse Park: Screenshot: [link-to-screenshot] shows the modal and the cert chain error.
IT_Support: Got it. I'll escalate replacement dock + missing power brick, shipping out same-day with 2-day expedited. For the Wi-Fi cert, can you try following the root-cert install and then forget/renew the network: System Settings > Network > Wi-Fi > redwood-sec > Forget, then Join and use EAP: TLS, Identity: Computer cert, or PEAP+MSCHAPV2 with SSO email if that matches your profile.
Dana (People Ops): Welcome Elyse!! Let me know if you need a mouse/keyboard swapped — we can add to the same replacement shipment. Also joining the 3pm intro would be great if you can make it.
Elyse Park: Installed the cert and rebooted — Wi-Fi joined successfully, thanks! Dock still dead though.
IT_Support: Perfect on the Wi-Fi. We'll leave the ticket open for hardware. Shipping label and tracking will be emailed to you shortly. We noted a replacement dock and power brick, plus an extra USB-A keyboard in the box.
Elyse Park: Appreciate it, thank you all. Will keep an eye out for the tracking.
Carlos Ramos: awesome, glad Wi-Fi is sorted. see you at 3pm :smile:
